slides.title: 5 quadratic facts the SAT turns into ^^traps^^
Discriminant
slides.tip: "How many solutions?" = they want D, not the roots

slides.title: Sum and product of roots
slides.tip: You never need to solve — just read the coefficients

slides.title: Vertex form
slides.body: See `(x + 3)²`? The vertex is at `x = −3`, not 3. Flip the sign of the number inside the parentheses. The unflipped version is always one of the choices.

slides.title: Average speed
slides.body: Don't average the two speeds. Add up ALL the distance, add up ALL the time, then divide. The simple average of the speeds is always a wrong answer choice.
